story_theme_en: Mark bought 1 pizza. It was cut into 4 equal pieces. Mark ate 3 pieces and gave 1 piece to his friend Lin. How many pieces does Mark have left? How many parts of the whole pizza does Lin have?
helper_tip: When adding or subtracting fractions, make sure the denominators are the same first.
hint_th: แบ่งเท่าๆ กัน ต้องทำส่วนให้เท่ากันก่อน

visual_blocks.title: Story
visual_blocks.content: Mark bought 1 pizza. It was cut into 4 equal pieces. Mark ate 3 pieces and gave 1 piece to his friend Lin. How many pieces does Mark have left? How many parts of the whole pizza does Lin have?

data.content_en: Mark bought 1 pizza. It was cut into 4 equal pieces. Mark ate 3 pieces and gave 1 piece to his friend Lin. How many pieces does Mark have left? How many parts of the whole pizza does Lin have?

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: 1 whole pizza = 4/4 pieces. Mark ate 3/4. Left = 4/4 - 3/4 = 1/4 piece. Lin got 1/4 of the whole pizza.

data.content_en: 1 whole pizza = 4/4 pieces. Mark ate 3/4. Left = 4/4 - 3/4 = 1/4 piece. Lin got 1/4 of the whole pizza.
